senses.gloss:
दृति दृति, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. दॄ;
cf. कृत्ति fr. rt. 2. कृत्), a skin of leather, a leather
bag for holding water and other fluids; a cloud
(Ved.); skin, hide; a pair of bellows; a fish; N.
of a man with the patronymic Aindroti or Aindrota;
[cf. दार्तेय; cf. also rt. दॄ; Gr. δέρ-ω, δείρ-ω,
δέρ-μα; Angl. Sax. teld, ‘a tent;’ Old Germ. gi-
zelt = Mod. Germ. zelt, ‘a tent.’]
—दृति-धारक,
अस्, m. a kind of plant, = आनन्दी, commonly आक-
नपाता.
—दृति-हरि, इस्, इस्, इ, carrying a leather
skin or leather bags (as cattle); (इस्), m. a dog.
—दृति-हार, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying a leather skin
or bag; (अस्), m. a carrier of skins or bags, a water-
carrier, &c.
